verbalization: Plantagineoside C appears to interact with the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 through a multi-step pathway. The evidence suggests that Plantagineoside C targets the Prostaglandin E2 receptor EP4 subtype, which in turn is a target of 10-O-Methylprotosappanin B. This chain of interactions implies a potential regulatory or signaling mechanism where Plantagineoside C may influence the activity of the transporter family member 1B3 through the modulation of its downstream receptor. The integration of these targets highlights a possible role for Plantagineoside C in modulating cellular processes via receptor-mediated pathways, potentially affecting anion transport. The evidence supports a mechanism where the interaction between Plantagineoside C and the receptor EP4 subtype may indirectly influence the transporter, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be elucidated.
